name: nxtphase-demo-video
description: How Nxt Phase AI makes demo and sales videos, as an invokable skill. Remotion project scaffold, the fixed brand end card, the ElevenLabs voice-over pipeline, the method for showing real interfaces instead of redrawing them, the anonymisation rules, a writing-style guide that keeps AI vocabulary and em-dashes out of client copy, a checklist built from real client feedback, and an optional step that publishes the matching demo page in the Notion Demo Library.
